decisions.decision: Use -itsoffset on cabin concat input instead of setpts filter
decisions.rationale: setpts STARTPTS is the first PTS seen by the filter. When overlay enable defers cabin frames, that PTS is ~1.932, not 0 — so the formula undershoots by ~1.932s. -itsoffset operates at demuxer level, is unambiguous.

Brio 100 V4L2 timestamps lead actual frame capture by ~0.5s (USB transfer + MJPEG encode pipeline). ELP H264 stream copy has near-zero latency. Subtracting 0.5 from cabin_shift aligns wall-clock capture times.

decisions.decision: cabin_pts_offset probed at render time from actual first-packet PTS in segments
decisions.rationale: Brio at 15fps produces slightly more segments than ELP at 30fps over time (~-1.93s after 6-8 mins, ~0.021s at startup). Probing at render time corrects this drift automatically.
